subject: [PATCH v3 6/7] selftests/mm: check MADV_PAGEOUT file permissions

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux kernel's selftests/mm suite to verify that the MADV_PAGEOUT functionality works correctly when used by an owner of a file or someone who can open it for writing. The test checks that the owner can page out clean pages of their own files, and that unauthorized callers cannot unmap shared file pages or page out COW pages from private mappings. The test also verifies that MADV_PAGEOUT can swap out anonymous memory and unmap clean file pages in /tmp. If any of these conditions are not met, the test skips itself to avoid false failures.

reviews.author: Sarthak Sharma
reviews.summary: Identified the need for additional tests to cover various scenarios of MADV_PAGEOUT behavior. Found the updated patch to address these concerns and deemed it acceptable.
reviews.raw_body:
On 10/19/26 10:42 PM, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> MADV_PAGEOUT only pages out file pages for a caller that owns the file or
> could open it for writing, per can_do_file_pageout(). Any other caller
> gets nothing from a shared file mapping, and only the anonymous COW pages
> from a private one.
> 
> main() now also checks once whether MADV_PAGEOUT can unmap a clean page
> of a file in /tmp, where the tests make their files. The tests below skip
> if it cannot, since none of them would show anything.
> 
> Check that the owner of a read-only file can page out a clean page of
> it. When started as root, the test hands the file to nobody and drops
> privileges, so that capabilities cannot stand in for ownership and
> nobody need not be able to write to /tmp.
> 
> Also check that an unauthorized caller leaves a shared file page mapped,
> and that it pages out the COW page of a private mapping but not the file
> page next to it. These need root to change credentials, and skip if that
> fails. The private mapping check also skips if MADV_PAGEOUT cannot swap.
> 
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
> ---
Thanks for the changes. It looks good to me.

Reviewed-by: Sarthak Sharma <sarthak.sharma@arm.com>

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch series adds selftests to verify the correctness of MADV_PAGEOUT, a feature that allows pages to be paged out for a caller that owns the file or could open it for writing. The tests check various scenarios, including pageout from an owned file, unauthorized access to shared files, and COW page handling in private mappings.
